dedupe_keys.name: ewater music and musicx stormwater and water sensitive urban design model

description: eWater MUSIC is a software tool that simulates the behaviour of stormwater in urban catchments to design and assess water sensitive urban design systems against water quality requirements. It works from the single lot to suburb scale, estimates stormwater harvesting and reuse potential and downstream effects, models suspended solids, total phosphorus and total nitrogen, and compares the quantity, quality and cost-benefit of treatment options such as bioretention, infiltration, media filtration, gross pollutant traps, buffer strips, rainwater tanks, wetlands and detention basins. MUSIC-link adds each subscribing council's guidelines and targets and reports compliance. The new MUSICX v2.1 imports MUSIC 6 files, runs faster and adds monthly climate scaling and Python extensions. Coverage is Australian practice, used by over 120 local governments and 13 universities. Access is commercial: the page invites users to buy MUSIC and eWater Solutions provides training and support. Caveats: prices and licence terms are not on the page, and the tool is built around Australian guidelines. Simulation uses: sizing stormwater treatment and harvesting systems in urban drainage planning. Related records: SWMM (model-epa-swmm) and CityDrain3 (model-citydrain3-integrated-urban-drainage-toolbox).
